exposure: management protocol for hemodynamic impairment (initial crystalloid infusion, cardiac ultrasound, second infusion/vasopressors)
cohort: Neonates born prematurely between 26 and 31 completed weeks of gestation who were managed for hemodynamic impairment within the first 24 hours of life at a level 3 NICU.
finding: Only 8 out of 68 neonates included in the study followed the management protocol for hemodynamic impairment, but all neonates responded to ultrasound-guided therapy.
followup_time: Within the first 24 hours of life
